Forward merges of main (1c0f147e, f00f51a7, 775d9b83): migrations renumbered to 0135-0140; CHANGELOG entries moved to packages/envoy/.changes/unreleased/INFRA-607-Changed-*.yaml; README, AGENTS.md, .dispatch/architecture resolutions
trickyParts: The stop's handler wait ends at whichever context ends first: Run's own (intakeStopBudget) or the caller's stop(ctx); a handler given up Naks rather than acks, so a handler that finished just before it was given up is redone by the next holder (idempotent upserts).

INFRA-592 (#2402) adds a shared shutdown deadline: the second to merge passes that deadline (a little inside it) to stopIntakes and drops intakeStopDeadline; #2402 also changes StartIntakes to take the leases pool as a parameter.
deviations: Round 2's measurement run directories were lost when the pod's scratch disk was recreated; its summary was rewritten from the measurement session's report (dispatch://INFRA-607/artifact/measurements-round-2-md), and the 1x comparison was re-run 26 times on a rebuilt stack.
The shutdown hook takes a context now, as INFRA-514's architect asked, rather than the context-free StopDelivering() first agreed with INFRA-558; INFRA-558's C5 calls StopDelivering(ctx).
discoveredComplexity: The CI envoy-go job at f00f51a7 timed out the internal/dispatch/api package at go test's default 10 minutes (600 s) on a runner about 35% slower than main's runs (docs took 495 s against main's 363 s); main's api package takes 454-482 s there, and this branch's api tests add about 18 s. CI at 775d9b83 runs on the new head.

The 1x collapse episode in both builds (one transaction holding the commit-order lock about 6.4 s through gaps between quick statements, 52 s into the load) is unexplained; dispatch://INFRA-591 removes that lock.
